description: Step 4.2 hand labels for the 15 shortlisted papers, same format as 026_labels.json, read by Claude from papers/<slug>/text/ on 2026-11-03. 'reuse' takes the outcomes from an earlier labels file. group_based marks outcome-wide group entries, whose ICD codes are handled separately. 'bins' maps an outcome to Step 2.8 bins as [bin id, scope].
